name: Vae Victis - Khan
source:
A prince, an escaped prisoner, a usurper, a lover, a fighter. Karder Dal-Arouya is many things but has one goal in life: to conquer the empire stolen from him by his treacherous queen mother.
Guide Karder on his adventures to reclaim his throne. On his quests you will meet friends and foes, powerful beasts and alluring rulers. Dominate your defeated foes and decide whether you want to use and abuse them for your dark pleasures or seduce them to aid you with their skills and knowledge.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/doorknob22]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
王子、逃犯、篡位者、情人、战士。卡德尔·达尔-阿鲁亚 (Karder Dal-Arouya) 身兼数职，但他的人生目标只有一个：征服被奸诈的太后从他手中夺走的帝国。
引导卡德踏上冒险之旅，夺回王位。在他的任务中，你会遇到朋友和敌人、强大的野兽和迷人的统治者。支配你被击败的敌人，并决定你是想利用和滥用他们来获得黑暗的快乐，还是引诱他们用他们的技能和知识来帮助你。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/doorknob22]Itch.io[/url]]
